response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior engineer with broad full-stack experience, real low-latency/high-throughput work (Sociomantic/dunnhumby), DevOps/Kubernetes exposure, and a visible record of mentoring through workshops, courses and open-source projects. However, the role's hard requirement of 8 years of C++ programming is not close to being met — C/C++ appears only in a ~7-month stint at National Instruments and a university thesis, with the bulk of his career in TypeScript/Node.js, D and web platforms. There is also no evidence of formal technical leadership of a cloud compute platform, large-scale infrastructure ownership, or production cloud architecture at the scale implied. The mismatch on the core language and platform-scale requirements is too large to justify an interview for this specific position, though he could be a good fit for a platform/full-stack role elsewhere.
strengths: Real experience with low-latency, high-throughput microservices (millions of req/s)
Strong mentoring/teaching track record: workshops, courses, conference talks, OSS maintainer
Broad polyglot depth plus DevOps/CI/Kubernetes and testing craftsmanship (TDD, trunk-based)
concerns: C++ experience is roughly 1 year, far short of the 8-year minimum
No formal technical leadership role or ownership of a cloud compute platform
Recent work is product/web-focused (TypeScript, React, MongoDB), not large-scale infrastructure

key_factors.factor: Lack of formal technical leadership / platform ownership
